snippet.title: HexTrains: Level 23, Version 1
snippet.description:
HexTrains trains your brains with trains!

Walkthrough video for the 1st version of the 23rd level of the game HexTrains. Game difficulty was set to "hard".

Please be aware that due to the realtime nature of the game, user experience may differ slightly.

HexTrains on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/866350

HexTrains site:
http://www.hextrains.com

Music by Eric Matyas
http://www.soundimage.org
